description: Starts a video with a genframe model and charges the account's credits (refunded if it fails). Videos take about 1–6 minutes: the result gives a job_id; call get_job with wait_seconds to get the link when it is ready. Optional first/last frame pictures as public https URLs or links from this server.

aspect_ratio.description: For example 16:9, 9:16, 1:1. With a first frame the frame's proportions win.

audio.description: Sound, for models that offer it (may change the price).

duration.description: Seconds, one of the model's options.duration (default 5 when offered).

first_frame_url.description: Picture to start the video from (image-to-video).

last_frame_url.description: Picture to end on (only models whose inputs.last is true; needs first_frame_url).

model.description: Video model id from list_models. Default: an inexpensive model.

prompt.description: What happens in the video. Any language. 3–1500 characters.

resolution.description: One of the model's options.resolution, e.g. 480p, 720p, 1080p (1080p and above need the Про plan).

name: generate_video
title: Generate a video
